long_biography.plain_text:
Darren Maupin began his investment career at Fidelity in 1998. Over nine years he worked in Boston, London and Hong Kong. He previously earned a degree in economics and finance from Boston College and studied in London and Beijing. He later founded Pilgrim Global. Its approach centres on market dislocations, long holding periods and conservative estimates of underlying business value.

Maupin has paired securities analysis with direct corporate involvement. He founded Anglo International Shipping and served on the board of MPC Container Ships. He also helped form Eldorado Drilling. That company raised capital to acquire and complete three unfinished deep-water rigs during an extended offshore downturn. Pilgrim has also become a substantial shareholder in a diversified maritime partnership and an offshore-energy producer, giving his investment work a sustained industrial focus.
